svg.title: #33 6790 JOHNSON RD, Fairburn (46.7 ac tax roll)
svg.text: #33 6790 JOHNSON RD, Fairburn (46.7 ac tax roll)
operator cross-dock 520 deep, courts + trailer rows, cars at
Trailer stalls 136 (court rows 136, drop yard 0) vs target 136
Site 46.7 ac (county map) 11,100 SF/gross ac FAR 0.26
Access: truck (T) + car (C); local road, GDOT route 1121200063409;
Graded area: relief ~37 ft, balanced cut/fill ~166,000 CY, steep
! RESIDENTIAL_EDGE: about 3,530 ft of boundary touches residential
parcels (county land-use codes); draft buffers applied
street frontage; this frontage reads as a local road
! LOADING_FACES_RES: a truck court or trailer row is within 150 ft
of a residential edge (50 ft loading strip and screening likely)
! RELIEF: about 37 ft of relief across the graded area: terraces
! ZONING_DRAFT: setbacks and buffers are draft screening values
for fairburn; zoning_rules.json is the authority
! STREAMS_PIPELINES: stream lines and petroleum pipelines are not
mapped; mapped water, wetlands and floodplain get a 25 ft buffer
i POND_SITE_FROM_LIDAR: pond placed low, near the module and on
its side of mapped wetlands; no outfall, maintenance drive or
paving envelope (draft setbacks/buffers, 25 ft from water)
Screening test fit from public data: not a survey, civil design or zoning
determination. Zoning values are draft; detention is a +/-30% estimate;
routes, fire access and grading are indicative.
